meta.title: MyKartos — a home for your family's memory
meta.description: Family tree, albums and memories in one private place. Build it together with your family.

hero.title: One place to remember everyone
hero.lead: Gather your family's story in one private archive: who was who, old photos and the memories worth keeping for your children.
hero.note: Free. You decide what others see.

facts.label: Only invited family can see it
And the first person is in the tree

hero.showLead: The family tree, a person's page and where they rest – all connected.

sample.name: Ona Jankauskienė
sample.memory: “She baked apple cake every Sunday and never once gave away the recipe.”
sample.directions: By the birch, third row from the chapel

keep.title: What you'll keep
keep.lead: Three things most often lost between generations.

tree.title: Family tree
tree.body: Parents, grandparents, children, spouses and second marriages. The tree grows as more relatives join.

map.title: Albums and photos
map.body: Old photos, letters and documents, gathered into albums and linked to the right people and years.

archive.title: Memories and stories
archive.body: What grandmother used to tell, how the grandparents met, what those years were like. With a photo, so it isn't forgotten.

steps.title: Your first person in a minute
steps.lead: No genealogy knowledge needed. Start with one person.

two.title: Add someone you want to remember
two.body: A name is enough. Dates, a photo and the grave can come later.

three.title: Invite your relatives
three.body: Share a link by Messenger, WhatsApp or email. Everyone adds what they know.

visit.title: When needed — family graves too
visit.body: You can mark where someone rests. Before All Souls' Day the younger ones no longer have to ask — they open the map and get directions to the grave.

privacy.title: Your family's history belongs to you

items.title: Private from the start
items.body: Only invited family members see anything. For each photo and memory you choose: family only, or everyone.

items.title: Living relatives protected
items.body: Dates, photos and places of living people are never shown publicly.

items.title: Export any time
items.body: Download all your data and photos, even if you stop using the service.

items.title: Never held hostage
items.body: Paid features only add to what you have. Your archive is never locked.

final.title: Don't let their stories be forgotten
final.body: Start with one name. The rest will follow: photos, dates and memories you'll keep for the generations to come.

footer.tagline: A family memory archive. Made in Klaipėda.

landing.reveal: Who was who. Who is in that old photo. What grandmother used to tell at the table. All of it is often lost within one generation — MyKartos helps keep it for your children and grandchildren.
landing.bigLead: An old photo from a drawer becomes a person's page, and that page becomes part of a story the whole family can see.
landing.storyTitle: From a photo to a family story

story.title: Upload an old photo
story.body: Take a picture of it with your phone — even a torn one. Mark who is in it.

story.title: The person appears in the tree
story.body: Parents, children and partners join them. The tree grows as relatives join.

story.title: And the whole family remembers together
story.body: Under the photo relatives leave a few words — who it is, when, what happened then.

landing.bandTitle: The whole family, in one place
landing.bandLead: Everyone adds what they know. The administrator checks it so the story stays accurate.
landing.treeTitle: A tree that grows with your family
landing.treeLead: Start with yourself or with the oldest person you know. Every relative you invite adds their own branch.

treeFacts.title: Several generations in one place
treeFacts.body: Great-grandparents, grandparents, parents, children and grandchildren — in one clear tree.

treeFacts.title: Real families, not diagrams
treeFacts.body: Second marriages, adopted children, cousins — everyone in their place.

treeFacts.title: Everyone adds their branch
treeFacts.body: An aunt knows her side, a cousin knows his. The administrator checks that it stays accurate.

landing.personTitle: Every person, with their own story
landing.personLead: Not just a name and dates. Who she was, what she loved, what she used to say. Leave memories for those who will never meet her.

personQA.a: Taught children at the Plungė school for 30 years.
Her garden, knitting and mushroom picking with the grandchildren.

personMemoryList.text: Every Sunday she baked an apple cake — only she knew the recipe.
During the war she hid the neighbours' children in the attic. She only told us when she was eighty.

together.title: Together with the whole family
together.lead: An archive stays alive while many hands fill it in. So everything is made to be easy for everyone to join — from grandchild to great-grandmother.

items.title: Albums you want to leaf through
items.body: Christmas at the grandparents', summers in the countryside, weddings. Open a photo full screen, or show albums as a slideshow at the family table.

items.title: Comments on photos
items.body: Anyone can leave a few words. They drift gently across the photo — with the name and face of whoever wrote them.

items.title: An invitation with your name
items.body: An invited relative sees straight away who they are in the tree. A link via Messenger, WhatsApp or email is enough.

items.title: Two families — one tree
items.body: When you marry, both families' trees join at you. Each family stays the owner of its own archive.
